public_rationale: Further errors occurred. In May 2024, Google acknowledged that its language-model search feature mishandled satire and offered nonsensical advice, including glue on pizza. Separate experiments documented commonsense reasoning failures with plausible explanations. These satisfy the ordinary recurrence reading. 'Even if' is treated as a concession, so an actual repair of the original Bard example is not required. The evidence does not establish that every future LLM must always have such failures.
limitations: The result depends on the stated readings of 'even if', 'similar flavor', and 'inevitably'.
AI Overviews combines a language model with retrieval and ranking; the evidence does not isolate which component caused each error.
The research evidence is a preprint about a limited task and also reports successful responses.
The original illustrated example was unavailable in the extracted post text.

statement.excerpt: And even if this specific example is patched up, there will inevitably be others of a similar flavor.

from_speaker: even if this specific example is patched up
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that further LLM outputs would contain fluent but obvious commonsense errors after the post.
I read 'even if' as a concession: recurrence is predicted whether or not the particular Bard example is repaired. It does not require a documented repair before the prediction applies.
'Similar flavor' refers to the surrounding description of plausible language containing obvious nonsense, rather than an identical question or error.
'Inevitably' expresses confidence that further examples will occur. I do not interpret it as a separately testable assertion that every future model must remain defective forever.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable records document subsequent LLM outputs containing obvious commonsense errors presented as plausible answers.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive record establishes that no further qualifying error can occur. A finite period without reported errors or correction of individual examples is insufficient because there is no deadline.
